title: Customers stored as "NET 30" keep that text and count under Net 30
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure customer A is stored with the text "NET 30".
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Note the Net 30 row's Customers count.
  2. Open customer A's customer page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • It includes customer A.

Step 2:

  • The "Credit term" reads "NET 30", the stored text (the release did not rewrite it).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S11-E2: “Customers whose stored term has an odd spelling (for example "NET 30") keep that stored text; they count under the matching term on the page and show their stored text on the card.”
  • S11-R9: “Customers and vendors with a blank term are counted under COD on the Credit Terms page; their records are not changed.”
  • Assumptions: “Stored customer and vendor terms carry inconsistent spellings from old imports and migrations (for example "NET 30" and "Due On Receipt"); every count, match and move treats names as equal when they differ only in capitals and spaces.”

From: Jira stories under epic SV-11638 (saved 23 Oct 2026, sources/JIRA-SV-11638-stories-2026-10-23.md), read 23 Oct 2026

  • Jira SV-11680 acceptance criterion: “Given customers stored as "NET 30", then the stored text is kept, they count under Net 30 on the page and their card shows "NET 30" (S11-E2).”
